title: Simon's identity 4.11 with its mass estimate: |T(g dη) − ∂T(gη)| = |T(dg ∧ η)| ≤ ∫ ‖Dg‖·|η| dμ
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be any set, T ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(U), μ, μ' measures on ℝ^P, ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_{k+1}(ℝ^P) and ξ' : ℝ^P → Λ_k(ℝ^P) such that |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for all (k+1)-covectors α for μ-a.e. x, T(ω) = ∫ ξ(x)(ω(x)) dμ(x) for all ω ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(U) and ∂T(θ) = ∫ ξ'(x)(θ(x)) dμ'(x) for all θ ∈ 𝒟^k(U). Let g : ℝ^P → ℝ be C^∞ and η ∈ 𝒟^k(U). Then, in [0, ∞], ofReal |∫ g(x)·ξ(x)(dη(x)) dμ(x) − ∫ g(x)·ξ'(x)(η(x)) dμ'(x)| ≤ ∫⁻ ofReal(‖Dg(x)‖·|η(x)|) dμ(x), where dη = exteriorDerivative η, ‖Dg(x)‖ is the operator norm of fderiv ℝ g x and |·| = covectorEuclideanNorm.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (k + 1)) (μ μ' : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P (k + 1)) (ξ' : Euclid P → MultiVector P k) (g : Euclid P → ℝ) (η : TestFormOn U k), (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) (k + 1), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (k + 1), T ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (k + 1)) x) ∂μ) → (∀ θ : TestFormOn U k, T.boundary θ = ∫ x, ξ' x ((θ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ') → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g → ENNReal.ofReal |∫ x, g x * ξ x (exteriorDerivative (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ - ∫ x, g x * ξ' x ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ'| ≤ ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (‖fderiv ℝ g x‖ * covectorEuclideanNorm ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x)) ∂μ
